szoveg_eredeti:
Today we’re releasing Scribe v3 Live Medical, real-time transcription optimized for clinical language.

Voice agents act on what they hear during a call. In our testing, a 3rd party speech model transcribed sitagliptin, a diabetes medication, as citalopram, an antidepressant. Scribe v3 Live Medical is built to get clinical details like these right.

On PriMock57, a public benchmark of mock primary care consultations, it had the lowest word error rate of the medical models we tested. Teams can also add up to 10,000 of their own terms, such as provider names or a full drug portfolio, and it supports more than 90 languages.

Available now in ElevenAgents.
